description: This file defines the class TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer, which implements policy enforcement logic for access control based on a policy tree. It contains methods to create a policy tree, check permissions, retrieve subjects with certain permissions, and build JSON views of resources with respect to policies.

classes.name: TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer
classes.description: An implementation of the Enforcer interface that maintains a policy tree and provides methods for access control checks and policy analysis.

classes.name: PointerAndValue
classes.description: Immutable class pairing a JsonPointer with its corresponding JsonValue, used in flattening JSON structures.

classes.name: PointerAndPermission
classes.description: Immutable class pairing a JsonPointer with a String representing a permission, used for tracking granted/revoked permissions on resources.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Builds a TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer from a given Policy object by constructing a policy tree.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a subject has unrestricted (full) permissions on a resource based on the policy tree.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns an EffectedSubjectIds object representing subject IDs that have certain permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns EffectedSubjects representing the subjects that have certain permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs that have at least partial permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects with at least partial permissions.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if any subject within an authorization context has partial permissions for a resource.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Constructs a JSON object representing a resource with respect to applied policies and permissions, filtering fields accordingly.
